value.rationale: The positive-feedback side of an equilibrium-line rational map is a natural unexplained global regime. Despite arbitrarily small initial transverse displacement, its nonfixed orbits have a strictly positive asymptotic escape velocity with an explicit bound and an exact logarithmic correction; this is a structural singular-scattering result, supported by complete invariant-probability classification rather than a rephrased local instability or routine numerical table.
